basic_info.description: Welcome to 42 Stoneybrook Ave, a charming single-family home built in 1942, ideally located near the Excelsior, Mission Terrace, and Portola neighborhoods. This bright and well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers a great blend of character, comfort, and potential.  The main level features a sunlit living room with a cozy fireplace, an open kitchen with a skylight, and two bedrooms that overlook the backyard. A skylight in the full bathroom further enhances the natural light throughout. The interior and exterior have been freshly painted, providing a clean and move-in-ready experience.  Downstairs, the garage level includes one-car parking, laundry hookups, and open space with great potential for future development or customization (buyers to verify with the city). The backyard offers a sunny patio/deck, ideal for outdoor enjoyment and entertaining. With convenient access to public transportation, parks, restaurants, shopping, and highways 101 & 280, this home is a fantastic opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
